display_name: Provision a managed role session on request
description: One-call composition for a requested named role session. It reads an existing role row first and honors its role_class; an unrecognized name defaults to project so callers do not need to know that Git-Controller is project-class. Only an explicitly requested, as-yet-unlegislated principal is legislated, and that governance act stays visible in the result. It then reuses spawn_session's local-name resolution and managed-dispatch path. The spawned worker receives the normal first-turn instruction to claim its own durable role binding; this verb never claims or evicts a holder on the worker's behalf. The Git-controller launcher check is report-only: it names the generated launcher files and whether GIT_CONTROLLER_NAME is armed, but never writes a launcher.
embedding_description: Provision a named project or principal role session without making the caller guess role class. Use for Git-Controller on request; defaults new names to project, legislates only a requested principal, and lets the worker claim itself.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: resolved_role_class, legislation outcome, managed dispatch and attempt, plus read-only Git-controller launcher-gate status.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: State the resolved class, whether legislation was performed, and the managed dispatch identity. For Git-Controller, surface the launcher gate result verbatim: armed is observation only and never changes launcher files.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Class resolution and authorization happen before legislation or managed dispatch. A principal legislation occurs only for an explicit requested principal with no existing role row; project roles are not legislated.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: missing_argument means role_name was empty. unknown_role_class means requested_role_class was not empty, project, or principal. role_class_not_spawn_assignable means the existing role row carries a class that spawn_session cannot assign. Authorization and dispatch failures retain their existing precise errors.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: For a standard project role such as Git-Controller, omit requested_role_class. Specify principal only when the caller intentionally requests a new principal office; resolve dispatch or launcher configuration failures using the exact returned detail.
